prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384 by 384 pixels. Modest detail appropriate for a small card. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, card frame or separate panels. Do not imitate an existing copyrighted card illustration. Clear plausible anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: An original stern fantasy judge-knight in chunky dark iron armor, a huge exaggerated white powdered judicial wig and a crimson cape. Bushy angry eyebrows, comically small spectacles, tiny boots under a broad armored body. No firearms, no logos, no eagle insignia, no resemblance to a comic-book police character.
